import { Message, ToolType, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "system", system: { content: "You are a helpful assistant." } } as Message, { role: "user", user: { content: "What is the weather in Paris?" } } as Message, { role: "assistant", assistant: { content: null, toolCalls: [{ function: { arguments: "{\"location\": \"Paris, France\"}", name: "get_weather" }, id: "call_xyz789", callType: ToolType.Function }] } } as Message, { role: "tool", tool: { content: "{\"temperature\": 18, \"unit\": \"celsius\", \"description\": \"Partly cloudy\"}", toolCallId: "call_xyz789" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4" });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
}

void main();
